Attribute VB_GlobalNameSpace = False
Attribute VB_Creatable = True
Attribute VB_PredeclaredId = True
Attribute VB_Exposed = False
Option Compare Database
Option Explicit
Private m_IsDirty As Boolean
Private Sub PopulateClientServiceNeeds()
    If Me.NewRecord Or IsNull(Me.ClientID) Then
        Me.lstClientServiceNeeds.RowSource = ""
        Exit Sub
    End If
    Dim fy As Integer
    fy = Nz(Me.cboFilterFiscalYear, basUtilities.GetCurrentFiscalYear())
    Dim baseSql As String
    baseSql = _
        "SELECT n.ClientServiceNeedID AS ID, " & _
               "n.FiscalYear AS FY, " & _
               "s.ServiceName AS [Service], " & _
               "n.HoursPerWeek AS [Hrs/Wk], " & _
               "n.Priority AS Priority " & _
        "FROM tblClientServiceNeeds AS n " & _
             "INNER JOIN tblServices AS s ON s.ServiceID = n.ServiceID " & _
        "WHERE n.ClientID=" & Me.ClientID & _
          " AND n.FiscalYear=" & fy
    Me.lstClientServiceNeeds.RowSource = basListHelpers.BuildAddableRowSource( _
        dataSelect:=baseSql, _
        addLabel:="(Add new...)", _
        dataColCount:=5)
    Me.lstClientServiceNeeds.Requery
End Sub
Private Sub PopulateClientBudgets()
    If Me.NewRecord Or IsNull(Me.ClientID) Then
        Me.lstClientBudgets.RowSource = ""
        Exit Sub
    End If
    ' Plain single-table SELECT with its own ORDER BY - Jet handles this fine.
    ' The helper handles the Add-row prepending + ColumnHeads in code, no UNION.
    Dim sql As String
    sql = _
        "SELECT b.ClientBudgetID AS ID, " & _
               "b.FiscalYear AS FY, " & _
               "Format(b.AnnualBudget,'$#,##0.00') AS [Annual Budget], " & _
               "b.Notes AS Notes " & _
        "FROM tblClientBudgets AS b " & _
        "WHERE b.ClientID=" & Me.ClientID & " " & _
        "ORDER BY b.FiscalYear DESC"
    basListHelpers.PopulateAddableListBoxFromAdo Me.lstClientBudgets, sql, "(Add new...)"
End Sub
Private Sub Form_Dirty(Cancel As Integer)
    m_IsDirty = True
    Me.btnSave.Enabled = True
End Sub
' ============================================================================
'  Double-click handlers: route through the shared OpenDetailFromList helper.
' ============================================================================
Private Sub lstClientServiceNeeds_DblClick(Cancel As Integer)
    ' For a NEW need we need to give the detail form the client + FY context
    ' (it'll pre-fill the FK columns on the new record).
    Dim ctx As String
    ctx = basListHelpers.BuildContextArgs( _
                "ClientID", Me.ClientID, _
                "FiscalYear", Nz(Me.cboFilterFiscalYear, basUtilities.GetCurrentFiscalYear()))
    basListHelpers.OpenDetailFromList Me.lstClientServiceNeeds, _
                                      "frmClientServiceNeedDetail", _
                                      ctx
End Sub
Private Sub lstClientBudgets_DblClick(Cancel As Integer)
    ' For Add mode, pass only ClientID and let the user choose the fiscal year
    ' (avoids defaulting to a FY the client already has a budget for, which
    ' would silently fail the unique Client+FY index on save).
    ' For Edit mode, OpenArgs is the PK and FY comes from the loaded record.
    Dim ctx As String
    ctx = basListHelpers.BuildContextArgs("ClientID", Me.ClientID)
    basListHelpers.OpenDetailFromList Me.lstClientBudgets, _
                                      "frmBudgetServicePlan", _
                                      ctx
End Sub

Private Sub cboFilterFiscalYear_AfterUpdate()
    PopulateClientServiceNeeds
    UpdateCopyButtonState
End Sub
Private Sub Form_Load()
    If IsNull(Me.OpenArgs) Then Exit Sub
    If UCase(Me.OpenArgs) = "ADD" Then
        DoCmd.GoToRecord , , acNewRec
    ElseIf IsNumeric(Me.OpenArgs) Then
        ' Restrict to the requested client so the user can't navigate elsewhere.
        Me.Filter = "ClientID=" & CLng(Me.OpenArgs)
        Me.FilterOn = True
    End If
End Sub
Private Sub Form_Current()
    ' Default the filter combo to the current fiscal year on first display.
    ' (Form_Load was the original hook, but the assignment didn't stick there.
    ' Form_Current re-fires on every record positioning, which is the more
    ' reliable hook for "default an unbound control on display.")
    If IsNull(Me.cboFilterFiscalYear) Then
        Me.cboFilterFiscalYear = basUtilities.GetCurrentFiscalYear()
    End If
    If Me.NewRecord Then
        Me.Caption = "New Client"
    Else
        Me.Caption = Nz(Me.txtFirstName, "") & " " & Nz(Me.txtLastName, "") & " - Client Detail"
    End If
    ' Update the "Copy from prior FY" button label and visibility based on
    ' whether prior-year data exists for this client.
    UpdateCopyButtonState
    ' Status bar
    On Error Resume Next
    With Me.RecordsetClone
        If Not (.BOF And .EOF) Then .MoveLast
        Me.lblRecordNav.Caption = "Record " & Me.CurrentRecord & " of " & .RecordCount
    End With
    On Error GoTo 0
    m_IsDirty = False
    PopulateClientServiceNeeds
    PopulateClientBudgets
    On Error Resume Next
    If Me.ActiveControl Is Me.btnSave Then Me.txtFirstName.SetFocus
    Me.btnSave.Enabled = False
End Sub
Private Sub Form_BeforeUpdate(Cancel As Integer)
    ' Tag-driven validation loop
    Dim ctl As Control
    For Each ctl In Me.Controls
        If ctl.Tag = "Required" Then
            If Len(Nz(ctl.Value, "")) = 0 Then
                MsgBox ctl.name & " is required.", vbExclamation, "Validation"
                ctl.SetFocus
                Cancel = True
                Exit For
            End If
        End If
    Next ctl
End Sub
Private Sub Form_Undo(Cancel As Integer)
    m_IsDirty = False
    Me.btnSave.Enabled = False
End Sub
Private Sub Form_Delete(Cancel As Integer)
    If MsgBox("Are you sure you want to delete this client?", _
              vbYesNo + vbQuestion, "Confirm Delete") = vbNo Then
        Cancel = True
        Exit Sub
    End If
    ' Check for child records
    If DCount("*", "tblClientBudgets", "ClientID=" & Me.ClientID) > 0 Then
        MsgBox "Cannot delete this client because they have budget records. " & _
               "Please delete the budget records first.", vbExclamation, "Delete Blocked"
        Cancel = True
    End If
End Sub
Private Sub txtLastName_BeforeUpdate(Cancel As Integer)
    ' Use .Text (in-progress edit), not .Value (locked during BeforeUpdate).
    ' Assigning to .Value here triggers Access error 2107 on save.
    Dim s As String
    s = StrConv(Trim(Nz(Me.txtLastName.Text, "")), vbProperCase)
    If s <> Me.txtLastName.Text Then
        Me.txtLastName.Text = s
    End If
End Sub
Private Sub txtFirstName_BeforeUpdate(Cancel As Integer)
    ' Use .Text (in-progress edit), not .Value (locked during BeforeUpdate).
    ' Prior version had a typo - referenced Me.txtLastName everywhere.
    Dim s As String
    s = StrConv(Trim(Nz(Me.txtFirstName.Text, "")), vbProperCase)
    If s <> Me.txtFirstName.Text Then
        Me.txtFirstName.Text = s
    End If
End Sub
Private Sub txtEmail_BeforeUpdate(Cancel As Integer)
    If Not IsNull(Me.txtEmail) Then
        If Not Me.txtEmail Like "*@*.*" Then
            MsgBox "Please enter a valid email address.", vbExclamation, "Invalid Email"
            Cancel = True
        End If
    End If
End Sub
Private Sub txtPhone_AfterUpdate()
    If Not IsNull(Me.txtPhone) Then
        Me.txtPhone = FormatPhone(Me.txtPhone)
    End If
End Sub
Private Sub txtSSNLast4_Exit(Cancel As Integer)
    Dim s As String
    s = Nz(Me.txtSSNLast4, "")
    If Len(s) > 0 Then
        If Len(s) <> 4 Or Not IsNumeric(s) Then
            MsgBox "SSN must be exactly 4 digits.", vbExclamation, "Validation"
            Cancel = True
        End If
    End If
End Sub
Private Sub cboStateCode_AfterUpdate()
    If IsNull(Me.cboStateCode) Then Exit Sub
    Dim sql As String
    sql = "SELECT City FROM tblClients " & _
          "WHERE StateCode=" & SqlQuote(Me.cboStateCode) & " AND City Is Not Null " & _
          "GROUP BY City"
    Dim rs As DAO.Recordset
    Set rs = CurrentDb.OpenRecordset(sql, dbOpenSnapshot)
    If Not (rs.BOF And rs.EOF) Then
        rs.MoveLast
        If rs.RecordCount = 1 Then
            rs.MoveFirst
            Me.txtCity = rs!City
        End If
    End If
    rs.Close
    Set rs = Nothing
End Sub
Private Sub cboStateCode_NotInList(NewData As String, Response As Integer)
    Response = acDataErrContinue
    MsgBox "Please select a valid state.", vbExclamation
End Sub
Private Sub txtDateOfBirth_AfterUpdate()
    Me.txtDateOfBirth.Requery
    ' txtAge has ControlSource "=CalcAge([DateOfBirth])" and auto-updates.
    ' Assignment from VBA was removed because calculated controls are read-only.
End Sub
Private Sub txtDateOfBirth_BeforeUpdate(Cancel As Integer)
    If Not IsNull(Me.txtDateOfBirth) Then
        If Me.txtDateOfBirth > DateAdd("yyyy", -18, Date) Then
            MsgBox "Client must be at least 18 years old.", vbExclamation, "Validation"
            Cancel = True
        End If
    End If
End Sub
Private Sub chkIsActive_AfterUpdate()
    If Me.chkIsActive = False Then
        If MsgBox("Are you sure you want to deactivate this client?", _
                  vbYesNo + vbQuestion, "Confirm Deactivation") = vbNo Then
            Me.chkIsActive = True
            Exit Sub
        End If
        ' Check for active plan entries
        Dim activePlans As Long
        activePlans = DCount("*", "tblClientServicePlan", _
            "Status='Approved' AND ClientServiceNeedID IN " & _
            "(SELECT ClientServiceNeedID FROM tblClientServiceNeeds WHERE ClientID=" & Me.ClientID & ")")
        If activePlans > 0 Then
            MsgBox "Warning: This client has " & activePlans & " active service plan entries. " & _
                   "These will be orphaned if the client is deactivated.", vbExclamation, "Warning"
        End If
    End If
End Sub
Private Sub btnSave_Click()
    If Me.Dirty Then Me.Dirty = False
End Sub
Private Sub btnCopyFromPriorFY_Click()
    ' Deep-copies all service needs (and their associated plan rows) for this
    ' client from the most recent populated prior FY into the FY currently
    ' selected in cboFilterFiscalYear. Replace-all semantics ? a single
    ' up-front prompt covers any existing target-year data.
    Dim targetFY As Long
    targetFY = Nz(Me.cboFilterFiscalYear, basUtilities.GetCurrentFiscalYear())
    Dim srcVar As Variant
    srcVar = basDataOperations.MostRecentPopulatedFY( _
                "tblClientServiceNeeds", _
                "ClientID=" & Me.ClientID, _
                targetFY)
    If IsNull(srcVar) Then
        MsgBox "No prior fiscal year has service needs to copy.", _
               vbInformation, "Nothing to Copy"
        Exit Sub
    End If
    Dim sourceFY As Integer
    sourceFY = CInt(srcVar)
    Dim srcNeedCount As Long
    srcNeedCount = DCount("*", "tblClientServiceNeeds", _
                          "ClientID=" & Me.ClientID & " AND FiscalYear=" & sourceFY)
    Dim tgtNeedCount As Long, tgtPlanCount As Long
    tgtNeedCount = DCount("*", "tblClientServiceNeeds", _
                          "ClientID=" & Me.ClientID & " AND FiscalYear=" & targetFY)
    tgtPlanCount = DCount("*", "tblClientServicePlan", _
                          "ClientServiceNeedID IN (SELECT ClientServiceNeedID " & _
                          "FROM tblClientServiceNeeds WHERE ClientID=" & Me.ClientID & _
                          " AND FiscalYear=" & targetFY & ")")
    Dim msg As String
    msg = "Copy " & srcNeedCount & " service need(s) (and their plan rows) " & _
          "from FY" & sourceFY & " into FY" & targetFY & "?"
    If tgtNeedCount > 0 Or tgtPlanCount > 0 Then
        msg = msg & vbCrLf & vbCrLf & _
              "FY" & targetFY & " currently has " & tgtNeedCount & " need(s) and " & _
              tgtPlanCount & " plan row(s) for this client. They will be replaced."
    End If
    If MsgBox(msg, vbQuestion + vbOKCancel + vbDefaultButton1, _
              "Copy from FY" & sourceFY) <> vbOK Then
        Exit Sub
    End If
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Dim needsCopied As Long, plansCopied As Long, plansSkipped As Long
    needsCopied = basDataOperations.CopyClientNeedsAndPlans( _
                        Me.ClientID, sourceFY, CInt(targetFY), _
                        overwrite:=True, _
                        plansCopied:=plansCopied, _
                        plansSkipped:=plansSkipped)
    Dim summary As String
    summary = needsCopied & " service need(s) copied." & vbCrLf & _
              plansCopied & " plan row(s) copied."
    If plansSkipped > 0 Then
        summary = summary & vbCrLf & vbCrLf & _
                  plansSkipped & " plan row(s) were skipped because the matching " & _
                  "provider does not offer the service in FY" & targetFY & "." & vbCrLf & _
                  "Run 'Copy from prior FY' on those providers' catalogs first, " & _
                  "then re-run this copy."
    End If
    MsgBox summary, vbInformation, "Copy Complete"
    PopulateClientServiceNeeds
    PopulateClientBudgets
    UpdateCopyButtonState
    Exit Sub
Failed:
    Select Case Err.Number
        Case basDataOperations.ERR_CANCELED
            ' silent ? user backed out of the inner overwrite prompt
        Case basDataOperations.ERR_SAME_FY
            MsgBox Err.Description, vbExclamation, "Invalid Fiscal Years"
        Case Else
            MsgBox "Error copying needs and plans: " & Err.Description, vbCritical
    End Select
End Sub
' ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
'  Refreshes btnCopyFromPriorFY's label and visibility based on the currently
'  selected target FY (cboFilterFiscalYear) and what prior-year data exists
'  for this client. Called from Form_Current and cboFilterFiscalYear_AfterUpdate.
' ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
Private Sub UpdateCopyButtonState()
    On Error Resume Next   ' button may not exist yet during form load
    If Me.NewRecord Or IsNull(Me.ClientID) Then
        Me.btnCopyFromPriorFY.Visible = False
        Exit Sub
    End If
    Dim targetFY As Long
    targetFY = Nz(Me.cboFilterFiscalYear, basUtilities.GetCurrentFiscalYear())
    Dim srcVar As Variant
    srcVar = basDataOperations.MostRecentPopulatedFY( _
                "tblClientServiceNeeds", _
                "ClientID=" & Me.ClientID, _
                targetFY)
    If IsNull(srcVar) Then
        Me.btnCopyFromPriorFY.Visible = False
    Else
        Me.btnCopyFromPriorFY.Caption = "Copy from FY" & CLng(srcVar)
        Me.btnCopyFromPriorFY.Visible = True
    End If
End Sub
